Frequency once per hour

Trigger An enemy targets you with a Strike.

Requirements There's at least one creature other than the triggering creature within 30 feet.

You play the ultimate prank on your foe, causing their blow to strike their own ally as you reveal you were somewhere else entirely. Choose a creature within 30 feet other than the triggering enemy; you switch places with that creature, and the triggering attack is resolved against it as if it were the original target. An unwilling creature can attempt to resist the effect with a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC; on a success, neither of you teleport, and the attack isn't redirected.
